title: Wayfare Pass Green-Rider All Access Discount — Questions Answered
content:
# Green-rider All Access discount — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

**What does it count?**
On a move up to Wayfare Pass All Access Annual, the Green-rider All Access discount counts the member's completed Wayfare Green trips dropped off in the last three months: 3 percent at 4 or more, 1 percent at 2 or 3, nothing below 2.

**Which trips?**
Trips in the member's trip records in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) in the Wayfare Green ride option, with status completed and a drop-off in the last three months.

**How does it act?**
It is taken off the All Access upgrade charge as that percentage of the All Access Annual membership fee of 249.00. The percentage is of the 249.00 fee itself; the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**What are the tiers and their edges?**

| Completed Wayfare Green trips, last three months | Discount |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 3 percent |
| 2 or 3 | 1 percent |
| 0 or 1 | nothing |

4 trips give 3 percent and 3 give 1 percent; 2 give 1 percent and 1 gives nothing.

**In money?** (hypothetical) 3 percent of 249.00 is 7.47; 1 percent is 2.49.
